# MDL002: mdl-unresolved-include

> Generated: do not edit this page. Regenerate with `cargo dev gen rules`.

| Field | Value |

| must_measure | false |
| version | 1 |
| since | 2.0.0 |

An include names a missing file, matches nothing, escapes the repository or is not readable.

Includes are structural: a file that is missing is an error, unlike a selector that matches nothing.

## Examples

### MDL002 unresolved include / An include of a missing file fires #1 (line 6) (fire)

```text
grimble = "2";
module m;
include "gone.grmb";
```

### MDL002 unresolved include / An include of an existing file is clean #2 (line 14) (clean)

```text
grimble = "2";
module m;
include "part.grmb";
=== design/part.grmb
grimble = "2";
part of m;
node a : trusted {
}
```
